title: Happy Baby in High Chair with Toy, 1950s Indoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white domestic snapshot featuring a cheerful infant sitting in a wooden high chair lined with a ruffled cushion. The smiling baby is dressed in light overalls and holds up a rubber squeak toy. An exposed brick wall or fireplace backdrop is visible behind the chair, capturing an authentic moment of mid-century childhood and family life.
